description: Synthesize supplied diligence into a decision-ready draft with bull/bear case, terms, returns and risks; the committee alone decides.

routing.when_to_use: Use when preparing a balanced, source-linked investment committee draft memo from diligence, deal, financial and return evidence.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: prescribed IC template; target overview; market evidence; historical financials and QoE adjustments; management/diligence findings; deal terms/sources-uses/capital structure; returns model with scenarios; risk evidence; decision criteria and date.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: structured draft memo sections, data-linked tables, open diligence, ranked but evidence-based risks and explicit committee decision questions.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Confirm deal scope, committee template, cut-off date, audience and confidentiality. Index inputs with source/ref/date; classify fact, management assertion, estimate and author inference. 2. Build executive summary with company, thesis, key terms and scenario returns only from reconciled model; label any proposed recommendation as draft. 3. Draft business/market/competitive sections using cited diligence; avoid unsupported market size or claims. 4. Summarize historical financials, QoE adjustments, working capital and capex; tie tables to source statements and flag adjustments without evidence. 5. Present value creation plan and 100-day priorities as proposed activities with owners/assumptions, not approved commitments. 6. Reconcile deal EV, S&U, leverage, key terms and returns; disclose gross/net fees/carry and model date. 7. Rank key risks by documented likelihood/impact where data supports; show mitigant, owner and unresolved diligence. Include downside and deal-breaker conditions. 8. Close with decision options/questions and exact conditions; do not imply IC vote, approval, signing or external distribution. 9. Run consistency checks across EV, EBITDA, S&U and returns; return as private draft.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
